root_cause: The two products contain the same set of pixel values but are arranged differently in space, causing low pixel-level agreement. Simple shifts and transpose do not resolve the mismatch, indicating a more complex spatial reordering (e.g., row/column permutation) rather than a simple translation or flip.

recommended_repair.description: Investigate the spatial ordering of the target product. Since global statistics match exactly, the data values are identical but permuted. Try sorting rows/columns by a key (e.g., latitude/longitude) or apply a permutation that aligns the products. Validate by recomputing agreement after reordering.
